Scenario fixture: iframe-focusable-content (tabindex="-1" frames must not contain focusable content)

Coverage note: this rule inspects iframe.contentDocument, which jsdom does not populate from a srcdoc attribute synchronously — only via a live load event or direct script mutation after parse. A static HTML page therefore cannot statically express a same-origin frame whose embedded document contains a real focusable element (the FAIL case). That branch is covered programmatically instead, in this rule's tests/engine-checks/automatic/iframe-focusable-content.test.js, via dom.window.document.getElementById(...).contentDocument.body.innerHTML = ... after the page is parsed. What IS expressible statically — and covered below — is every other branch: not applicable, and pass (empty embedded document).

A. Not applicable (skipped, not counted)

01 — NEUTRAL: iframe with no negative tabindex

B. Applicable, pass

02 — PASS: tabindex="-1", embedded document has no focusable content (jsdom's default empty document for a bare iframe)

End of fixture.
